transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Well... I suppose I'm just getting tired of having to plan my days around things. 

I've been... steering clear of my own workshop lately. And I don't really go to family get-togethers anymore, not if my brother-in-law might be there. I just... after all this time, I'm tired of trying so hard not to run into those reminders. So, that's why I'm here, I guess.
Do you avoid certain places or situations because you're afraid you might have a panic attack or feel trapped, helpless, or embarrassed?
No... it's not that. I don't get panic attacks or anything like that. I just... I just prefer not to be around the things I mentioned. It's not about being embarrassed.
Can you tell me more about why you avoid your workshop and family gatherings where your brother-in-law might be? Is there something specific that happened or that you're trying to avoid?

Well... it's just... I've been doing this for a while now. Ever since, uh... well, there was a confrontation with my brother-in-law. That was... I guess about two years and four months ago. So, it's just been since then.
Can you tell me more about the confrontation with your brother-in-law and how it made you feel at the time?

Well... I'd really rather not get into the details of all that. It was just... things got out of hand. 

It was a bad day. I didn't feel good about it, obviously. I just... I'd prefer not to hash it all out again, if that's alright. It was just unpleasant. That's all.
